query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.latin_name, p.category, p.olfactive_signature
FROM plants p
LEFT JOIN plant_molecules pm ON p.id = pm.plant_id
WHERE pm.plant_id IS NULL
ORDER BY p.name
LIMIT 30
